description: AutoPoco is a highly configurable framework for the purpose of fluently building readable test data from Plain Old CLR Objects. This is a modernized (i.e. net6 and higher) port of the excellent AutoPoco project which hasn't been maintained since 2014.
releaseNotes: 7.0: Breaking: targets .NET 10 and .NET 11 only. .NET 8 and .NET 9 are out of support since 2026-11-10 and no longer targeted, stay on 6.1.x for them. .NET 11 converts a double to a decimal close to exactly instead of rounding to 15 significant digits, which would have changed the values of NumberSource<decimal> and DecimalSource for the same seed; AutoPoco now does that conversion itself the way .NET 8 to 10 did, so the values stay the same on every runtime. On .NET 11 NumberSource<T> and NullableNumberSource<T> also generate the IEEE 754 decimal types Decimal32, Decimal64 and Decimal128. 6.1: New data sources for trade identifiers in holonsoft.AutoPoco.DataSources.Identifiers: GtinSource and Ean13Source (GTIN-8/12/13/14, i.e. EAN-8, UPC-A, EAN-13 and ITF-14, with a valid GS1 mod 10 check digit and an optional GS1 company prefix), SsccSource (the eighteen digit number of a logistic unit, same GS1 check digit, optional prefix), IsbnSource (ISBN-13 inside an allocated registration group, ISBN-10 with its mod 11 check digit including the X), IssnSource (mod 11 check character including the X), IsinSource (a real country prefix or a given one, Luhn over the expanded letters), ImeiSource (Luhn check digit, optional Type Allocation Code prefix) and AsinSource, each with a Nullable variant. IbanSource generates the IBAN of any SEPA country with correct mod 97 check digits and the national check digits inside the BBAN (BE, EE, ES, FI, FR/MC, HU, IS, IT/SM, NO, PL, PT, SI), TestBlzIbanSource a German IBAN on a bank code outside the assigned range so the number is recognisable as test data, and VatIdSource a VAT ID with a valid check digit for AT, BE, DE, DK, EE, FI, GB, HR, HU, IE, IT, LT, LU, NL, PL, PT, SE, SI, SK and XI, calibrated against the official construction rules; countries that have not published their rules are left out on purpose. More sources: VinSource (North American check digit, model year per 49 CFR 565, optional WMI prefix), MacAddressSource and TestMacAddressSource (universally vs. locally administered unicast, three formats), GuidV7Source (RFC 9562 version 7 UUIDs whose timestamp comes from a seeded range instead of the clock), PatternSource (# digit, @ letter, * both, backslash escapes) with SkuSource, SerialNumberSource and LotNumberSource (seeded year plus day-of-year date code) on top, and LatitudeSource/LongitudeSource with bounding box. EoriSource generates EORI customs numbers for BE, DE, DK, FR, GB, HR, IT, NL, PL and XI, the national part built from the underlying national identifier with its real check digits (enterprise number, CVR, SIRET, OIB, partita IVA, NIP, VAT registration number). TestBinCreditCardSource in holonsoft.AutoPoco.DataSources.Business builds card numbers on the six digit test BINs the payment processors publish, so the data is recognisable as test data. Bug fixes: CreditCardSource doubled the wrong digits when calculating the Luhn check digit, so its numbers failed a real Luhn validation; and only the first digit of the scheme was fixed, so an "American Express" could be detected as a Diners Club and a "MasterCard" could start with 56, a range no scheme issues. Every number now carries a correct check digit and starts inside a range its scheme really issues in (34/37 for American Express, 51-55 and 2221-2720 for Mastercard, 6011/644-649/65 for Discover), and the generated sequences changed once for that. 6.0: Lambda data sources (FuncSource, Setup(...).From(() => ...), Source(expr, () => ...) at generation time). Opt-in nullability-aware null generation via RespectNullableAnnotations(threshold). Generic NumberSource<T> and NullableNumberSource<T> with min/max for every built-in numeric type (integers uniform and inclusive, floating point and decimal overflow safe). Records and immutable types are constructed through their constructor, parameters are fed from the registered members with the same name, no parameterless constructor needed anymore; unconfigured struct parameters stay default instead of throwing. Seeds: UseSeed(seed) per factory, CreateSession(recursionLimit, seed) per session, every member gets its own stream derived from the seed. Own deterministic generator (StableRandom, xoshiro256**) instead of System.Random, sequences are stable across .NET versions. Breaking: AutoPocoGlobalSettings removed (AutoPocoDefaults constants instead), every generated sequence changed once, the max of IntegerSource/LongSource/RandomNumberSource and their nullable variants is inclusive now (it was exclusive), Int128Source/NullableInt128Source pick uniformly instead of clamping to the bounds (they never produced a negative value before), RandomStringSource and UrlSource reach the last character resp. the last top level domain, ColorSource/RandomTextSource/RandomUtfTextSource treat their maximum as inclusive, ColorSource applies the alpha of SetColorRange, and UrlSource and ExtendedEmailAddressSource seed their nested sources (the URL host ignored the session seed completely). CreditCardSource never produced a Discover card. TimeSpanSource was rewritten: it returned TimeSpan.MinValue on every draw of the default range, produced values outside a requested range and looped forever on a reversed one. DoubleSource returned infinity over its default range, DoubleSource/FloatSource/DecimalSource interpolate overflow safe now and DecimalSource keeps its full precision. Index-aware Impose on lists and selections (value from the position, or from position and item), Impose(member, item => value) on a single generator. Invoke arguments: Use.From(lambda), constants and variables arrive as values. Context lambdas get a non-nullable IGenerationContext. Argument validation over the public API, meaningful exception messages, XML documentation file. IDataSource<T> is covariant. Bug fixes: Nullable* sources honor an explicit null creation threshold (null positions of stable sequences changed), DateTime/DateOnly/TimeOnly/DateOfBirth sources cover their whole range including the upper bound (sequences changed), RandomUtfTextSource no longer loops forever. Build and packaging modernized: GitHub Actions CI, trusted publishing to nuget.org, MinVer tag based versioning, central package management, xunit.v3 tests on net8/9/10. FluentAssertions and Moq are no longer dependencies of the library. See README for details.
title: AutoPoco by holonsoft
